lines.en: Even roller coasters, Without them clocks stop ticking.
lines.zh: 烤面包机、电视屏幕，甚至过山车。

lines.en: Without them lights go out,
lines.zh: 没有它们灯光就会熄灭

lines.en: But if you meet a Fixie, please, Don't let their secret out!
lines.zh: 但如果你遇到了修理工，千万别泄露他们的秘密！

lines.en: The Nightlight
lines.zh: 小夜灯

lines.en: They're very close. I can feel them!
lines.zh: 它们就在附近，我能感觉到它们。

lines.en: Help me! Help me! Help me!
lines.zh: 救救我！救救我！救救我！

lines.en: That's all. You've had enough monsters.
lines.zh: 这就是你全部的内容。

lines.en: It's not good to watch these kinds of movies before bed.
lines.zh: 看够了怪物电影，睡前看这种电影不好

lines.en: Mom! Mom, really, I'm not scared. Let me watch the end, would you?
lines.zh: 妈妈，妈妈，真的，我不害怕，让我看完结尾好吗？

lines.en: I told you, that's all.
lines.zh: 我跟你说过，就这些了。

lines.en: Well, good night, honey.
lines.zh: 好吧，晚安，宝贝。

lines.en: Pfft! Who's there?
lines.zh: 啊，谁在那儿？

lines.en: They're very close. I feel them.
lines.zh: 他们很近，我感觉到了。

lines.en: Can you believe it?
lines.zh: 你敢信吗？

lines.en: He's sleeping and he didn't turn the light off!
lines.zh: 他睡着了，居然没关灯。

lines.en: Yeah, and so? And so,
lines.zh: 是啊

lines.en: if every human went to sleep with a light on,
lines.zh: 如果每个人都开着灯睡觉

lines.en: there wouldn't be enough electricity to go around.
lines.zh: 那电力就不够用了。

lines.en: Everyone can probably remember walking into an empty room with the lights turned on,
lines.zh: 每个人可能都记得走进一个空房间，发现灯还亮着

lines.en: or finding a TV on that nobody's watching.
lines.zh: 或者发现电视开着，却没人看。

lines.en: One little light or TV might not seem like much,
lines.zh: 一台小小的电视机看起来似乎没什么大不了

lines.en: but just imagine how many people are living on this Earth!
lines.zh: 但想想地球上有多少人生活。

lines.en: Well,
lines.zh: 好吧

lines.en: if everybody forgot to turn off the
lines.zh: 如果每个人都忘记

lines.en: lights or TV when they weren't being used,
lines.zh: 在不使用时关灯或关电视

lines.en: the amount of wasted electricity would equal the
lines.zh: 浪费的电力相当于

lines.en: amount of energy produced by a hundred power plants.
lines.zh: 一百座发电厂的发电量。

lines.en: And each of these power plants needs freight cars
lines.zh: 而每座发电厂都需要大量的

lines.en: of coal or rivers of oil to keep running.
lines.zh: 煤炭或石油才能运转

lines.en: And all that fuel has to be extracted and burned constantly.
lines.zh: 所有这些燃料都必须不断开采和燃烧。

lines.en: Now do you see how expensive burning a light bulb is for the earth?
lines.zh: 你怎么知道点亮一个灯泡有多贵呢？地球

lines.en: So don't forget to turn off electrical appliances when you're not using them.
lines.zh: 所以别忘了不用电器的时候关掉它们

lines.en: It's so easy! Who turned off the light?
lines.zh: 这很容易。谁关灯了？嗯

lines.en: They're very close. I feel them. I feel them.
lines.zh: 他们离得很近，我感觉到了，我感觉到了

lines.en: I feel them. Look! What's up with him?
lines.zh: 我感觉到了。看看他怎么了

lines.en: I think he's playing sleep hockey. Looks like his position is left out.
lines.zh: 我觉得他在玩睡眠曲棍球，看起来他的位置被漏掉了

lines.en: Ha -ha!
lines.zh: 哈哈。总之

lines.en: Anyway, he should get a penalty for wasting electricity.
lines.zh: 他应该因为浪费电而被罚。

lines.en: Monsters! Hey! What do you think we are?
lines.zh: 怪物们。嘿，你以为我们是什么？

lines.en: Hockey pups? Nolik! Simka!
lines.zh: 曲棍球吗？别看，辛卡

lines.en: Forgive me! Who did you think we were? Monsters.
lines.zh: 原谅我，你以为我们是谁？怪物们。

lines.en: Well, I see how you could mistake Simka for one.
lines.zh: 好吧，我明白你为什么会把辛卡误认为怪物

lines.en: But obviously not me. Tom Thomas, what are you doing?
lines.zh: 但显然你不会把我误认为怪物。汤姆·托马斯，你在干什么？

lines.en: Why are you sleeping with the light on?
lines.zh: 你为什么开着灯睡觉？

lines.en: I was so dumb. I watched this monster movie on TV before bed.
lines.zh: 我太蠢了，睡前在电视上看了一部怪物电影

lines.en: Now I'm scared to sleep without the light on.
lines.zh: 现在我不敢不开灯睡觉了。

lines.en: And that dumb old monster flick, why were you watching it?
lines.zh: 还有那部愚​​蠢的老怪物电影，你为什么在看它？

lines.en: I felt like getting scared. You're great at getting scared!
lines.zh: 我感觉自己快要被吓到了。你很擅长被吓到。

lines.en: Keep quiet, or we'll wake up your mom and dad!
lines.zh: 安静点，否则我们会吵醒你爸爸妈妈。

lines.en: How am I going to fall asleep now?
lines.zh: 我现在怎么睡得着？

lines.en: Here's a good idea. You can use a nightlight.
lines.zh: 有个好主意，你可以用夜灯。

lines.en: A nightlight is a little light that humans who don't
lines.zh: 夜灯就是那种不喜欢在黑暗中睡觉的人

lines.en: like to sleep in the dark use in their rooms.
lines.zh: 在房间里用的灯

lines.en: The nightlight has a dim glow. That's because it works with the special kind
lines.zh: 它发出昏暗的光芒，因为它用的是一种特殊的灯泡

lines.en: of light bulb that uses very little electricity.
lines.zh: 耗电量非常低。

lines.en: These kinds of light bulbs are called energy efficient.
lines.zh: 这种灯泡叫做节能灯泡

lines.en: That's hard to say.
lines.zh: 虽然很难说出口。

lines.en: And you can find night lights that use such low
lines.zh: 你可以找到一些使用超低能耗灯泡的夜灯

lines.en: -energy bulbs that they can work off of a battery.
lines.zh: 它们甚至可以用电池供电。

lines.en: But you know there isn't a night light here.
lines.zh: 但是你知道，这里没有夜灯，嗯？

lines.en: How would you get by without us? Tonight I'm here to help you.
lines.zh: 没有我们，你今晚该怎么办？我来帮你​​

lines.en: I'm gonna be your night light. Look!
lines.zh: 我就是你的夜灯。看

lines.en: Right there! There's our lampshade. Thanks so much!
lines.zh: 就在那里，那是我们的灯罩。非常感谢

lines.en: You really are a friend indeed, Nolik. It was easy.
lines.zh: 你真是个好朋友。不，你看，这很容易

lines.en: Just go to sleep. Nolik. Do you know any good stories?
lines.zh: 睡吧。不，你看，嗯，你知道什么好故事吗？

lines.en: I know one about... a big meat grinder!
lines.zh: 我知道一个关于大型研磨机的故事。

lines.en: Nah, no way. You'd better tell me a story about a nice kind fixie.
lines.zh: 不，不行，你最好给我讲一个关于善良的固定齿轮自行车的故事。

lines.en: Ah! I know a good one! And here's how it goes.
lines.zh: 啊，我知道一个好故事，是这样的

lines.en: Grandpus was working inside of a very old factory.
lines.zh: 爷爷的固定齿轮自行车在一个很大的钟里工作。

lines.en: big clock. Actually, the clock wasn't that big.
lines.zh: 实际上，那个钟并没有那么大

lines.en: I'm not sure if it was Rampus, but it was a clock. I think.
lines.zh: 我不确定是不是爷爷的，但它确实是一个钟。你相信吗？即使放大，也很难
